rationale.conceptual: The method involves an established but non-trivial CNN architecture (custom Colorful CNN) trained on a specific dataset, along with kernel ridge regression (FCHL) requiring careful representation selection and subset selection. Evaluation metrics (repulsive wall, attractive forces, etc.) demand domain knowledge in potential energy surfaces.
rationale.execution: The pipeline has 7+ sequential stages: data subset preparation, training two separate ML models (CNN on full dataset, FCHL/KRR on subset), acquiring test sets, running inference for many geometries, and computing multifaceted metrics. It involves multiple external libraries (QML, libmolgrid, pretrained model repositories) and numerous fragile handoffs.

difficulty.reasoning: The paper evaluates existing ML methods, but the reproduction task requires implementing a custom CNN and training it on a large dataset, plus careful domain-specific evaluation. The pipeline is long and involves multiple models, data curation, and metric computation, making execution substantial.

compute_estimate.reasoning: Training the Colorful CNN on the full ANI-1x dataset (millions of geometries) requires a GPU; the raw dataset is a few GB; peak RAM may reach ~24 GB for data loading.
